scope: fixed-geometry, small-strain, laterally uniform layered column under a constant external driving force: disjoint generalised drag plus layered column resistance solved at every stage, with conduction of the column's own creep/plastic dissipation feeding temperature back into the reviewed weakening law; not advection, finite strain, melting, rupture, breakup, spherical/world assembly, native integration or calibration

provenance.mechanics_and_heat: reviewed cases/i01_column_heat_v1.json (bound by the column-heat r2 receipt) and, through it, cases/i01_weakening_v1.json: layers, densities, rheology, weakening law, gravity, inherited history, thermal layer properties, boundary temperatures, heat fractions (1, 1) and the homogeneous oracle layer, all unchanged
provenance.drive: reviewed cases/i01_motion_coupling_v1.json (bound by the motion-coupling r1 receipt): drive 2e13 N/m of strike, generalised drag 5e22 Pa s, belt width 1e5 m, used unchanged; authored controls, not calibrated Earth values
provenance.duration: 1e13 s, the longest window for which the drag-only bound |a| <= |F|/(D w) = 4e-15/s guarantees |strain| <= 0.04 < 0.05 whatever the column does; chosen from that bound, not from a target speed. The motion case's own 3e13 s window is not reused because it has no such a priori small-strain guarantee
provenance.initial_state: zero temperature departure from the column-heat discrete steady reference (heat.steady_k); the weakening case's linear template temperatures are only the preparation template; inherited plastic history from the weakening case
provenance.homogeneous_oracle: the column-heat case's insulated uniform wet-quartzite layer (10 km, 600 K, supplied 150 MPa mean pressure, initial engineering history 2.0) unchanged; it is driven by the same motion-case force, drag and width for the same 1e13 s instead of the column-heat oracle's supplied 1e-15/s rate
provenance.authored: step counts, quadrature orders, the rest departure amplitude, the refusal fixtures and the four new refinement gates are authored control inputs frozen before any run

representation.geometry: fixed laterally uniform column and belt width; material depth coordinates; small strain; no advection
representation.control: constant external driving force balanced by disjoint generalised drag and the layered column resistance at every stage
representation.thermal: reviewed column-heat conduction on the mechanical Gauss control volumes with constant declared layer properties; initial state is its discrete steady reference
representation.heating: column creep plus plastic dissipation deposited once per control volume; external drag dissipation is not column heat
representation.time_integration: retained ETD2 conduction with Heun history, strain, displacement and work; accepted endpoint re-solved before commit

drive.source: motion case drive_n_m, drag_pa_s and width_m, unchanged
